subject: BYOK KMS orchestration sprint sync and readiness checklist
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Slater <john.slater@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: BYOK KMS orchestration sprint sync and readiness checklist

Hi John,

Thanks again for a productive call yesterday. As we head into the engineering sprint next week, we want to lock down the BYOK orchestration expectations so the on-prem deployment goes smoothly. Below is a short checklist we use internally — can you confirm the items we discussed or flag any deviations on your side?

Quick checklist (please reply inline):
- KMS/HSM model & firmware version identified (include serials)
- Network egress rules to allow KMS management & attestation endpoints
- Operator account model (number of operator keys, rotation cadence)
- Key import process (manual vs. automated via PKCS#11/CLI)
- Audit log forwarding (SIEM target, retention)
- Disaster recovery: key backup/escrow approach and access model
- Maintenance window constraints for firmware/key ceremonies

I've attached our BYOK integration questionnaire to make it easier to capture these specifics. If you prefer, we can also run a 30-min whiteboard session with your infra team this week.

Planned internal owners:
- Sean: orchestration and rollout policy
- Monica: operator/oncall procedures and acceptance tests
- Vivek: network/routing and private peering validation

Next steps: please return the completed questionnaire or call out any items that need alternate handling.

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
[Attachment: BYOK-integration-questionnaire.pdf]
From: John Slater <john.slater@acme-analytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics Security <security@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK KMS orchestration sprint sync and readiness checklist

Sean —

Appreciate the checklist. See inline answers and a network diagram attached for the VPC layout.

- KMS/HSM: Thales offline HSM (nShield Connect), firmware 3.8.2; serials included in the attached asset export.
- Network egress: Management plane is allowed to reach our attestation endpoint (attest.acme-analytics.com) on 443; outbound to Redwood control plane will be via a private peering (no public egress).
- Operator model: We have 3 named operator accounts; we rotate split keys every 90 days.
- Key import: We plan to use PKCS#11 tooling for an initial manual import, then script via our CI for subsequent imports.
- Audit logs: Forwarding to Splunk; 1 year retention for security events.
- DR/Escrow: Keys will be backed up encrypted into an external HSM escrow (vendor-managed). Access requires 2-of-3 operator approval via our on-call process.
- Maintenance windows: Weekly Fri 00:00-04:00 UTC preferred; ceremonies scheduled outside business hours.

Questions from our infra lead:
1) What is Redwood's expected attestation handshake? Do you require mTLS with client certs or token-based attestation?
2) Can the orchestration run entirely over the peered VPC (no public endpoints)?

Happy to jump on a call if that is easier.

—John
John Slater
Senior Security Engineer, Acme Analytics
john.slater@acme-analytics.com
[Attachment: acme-vpc-network-diagram.vsdx]
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK KMS orchestration sprint sync and readiness checklist

Sean —

Thanks for sharing John's answers. Two quick operational asks from my side before we finalize the sprint ticket:

1) Operator UX: we need a short step-by-step for the initial manual import (PKCS#11 CLI), including expected CLI exit codes and typical troubleshooting. Could John/Acme provide the exact HSM vendor CLI version they plan to run?

2) Attestation & auth: if the peering path supports mTLS with client certs, that would be our preferred flow for attestation. If not, token-based attestation with short-lived signed tokens is acceptable but we should document the failure/fallback policy.

I started a working doc (internal) with a minimal acceptance checklist and a stub runbook. Putting it here for visibility: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BYOKQ_dummy

Vivek — can you validate that Redwood's orchestration can operate over private peering only (no public egress) and list any firewall rules we will need to open inbound for control-plane callbacks? If you can paste the rules in a reply, I'll include them in the operator runbook.

Monica Patel
Senior Product Manager, Platform Security
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: BYOK KMS orchestration sprint sync and readiness checklist

John / Acme team —

Appreciate the prompt responses and the diagram. Summary + next actions below. Keeping this short for your infra calendar.

Summary of confirmed items:
- HSM: Thales nShield Connect, firmware 3.8.2 (confirmed).
- Attestation: prefer mTLS over private peering. If Acme can terminate client certs on their attestation endpoint, we'll use that path; fallback is short-lived signed tokens.
- Network: orchestration will run exclusively over peered VPC (no public egress). Vivek will post the exact firewall rules we need to allow.
- Operator model & rotation: 3 operators, 90-day split-key rotation.
- Audit & DR: Splunk forwarding + 1y retention; escrow via vendor HSM with 2-of-3 operator approval.

Immediate actions (owners & ETA):
- Acme: confirm HSM CLI version and provide any vendor-specific import steps (ETA: 2027-04-22) — John
- Vivek (Redwood): post firewall rule set and required ports for the orchestration control-plane (ETA: 2027-04-21) — Vivek
- Monica: finalize operator runbook and acceptance test checklist and share with Acme (ETA: 2027-04-23) — Monica
- Sean: schedule a 30-min validation call with Acme infra following Vivek's rule post (ETA: 2027-04-24) — Sean

Attachments & references: BYOK-integration-questionnaire.pdf, acme-vpc-network-diagram.vsdx; internal working doc: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BYOKQ_dummy; HubSpot record HS-57321.

If that timeline works I will convert these into sprint tickets and link them to the shared HubSpot record.

Thanks all — looking forward to a smooth cutover.

Sean Gallagher
